svg.title: Chimera — System Architecture
svg.desc: Chimera is a multi-LLM, tools-capable autonomous agent built on a thin Python core. It is invocation-driven: one 9-phase cycle (HOUSEKEEPING→WAKE→ASSESS→PLAN→ACT→WRITE→FLUSH→COMMIT→ROTATE) runs per `chimera run`, with cadence supplied externally by a soak runner or cron. The ACT phase fans out tools in parallel and calls LLMs through cost-cascade tier ladders (Anthropic / OpenRouter / Sakana), cheapest rung first, under three orthogonal spend caps. A verification layer (critic gate, cross-provider witness panel, scope + repo-verify gates) blocks unfaithful or off-charter commits. SQLite is the source of truth for a KFM ontology (entities + transitions), with a derived Kuzu graph and FTS5 wiki for recall. A self-steering feedback tier — autonomous engines, composite drift scoring, and a T0–T5 trust ladder — closes the loop each FLUSH; escalation memory promotes failed tasks a tier on the next attempt. Chimera scans itself, authors charters, and opens trust-gated DRAFT PRs to its own and foreign repos. It federates with peer nodes as an MCP server (stdio + HTTP/SSE bearer auth) under an ALLOW/DEGRADE/REFUSE trust policy, and surfaces everything through a read-only Next.js control-plane. ~90 CHIMERA_* flags live in one CI-enforced registry; mutations are proposals the operator disposes.
svg.text: A multi-LLM, tools-capable autonomous agent · invocation-driven 9-phase cycle · SQLite/KFM source of truth · closed drift·trust·escalation feedback · v4.120
ONE AGENT, NO ORCHESTRATOR · the loop is its own scheduler — `chimera run` executes exactly one 9-phase cycle; cadence is external (soak runner / cron re-invokes it).

Source of truth = SQLite state/chimera.db (KFM entities + transitions + api_calls + mutations + task_escalations; WAL, user_version=4) and mind/*.md narrative. Kuzu graph + FTS5 wiki are DERIVED, rebuildable.
Self-steering = FLUSH scores composite drift + trust readiness each cycle; escalation memory promotes a failed task one tier next attempt — a closed feedback loop back into the scheduler.
Chimera proposes, operator disposes = every mutation, self-PR and foreign-PR is a trust-gated, fail-closed DRAFT; ARCHIVED→KILLED and PR merges are operator-gated.
⑧ DRIFT · TRUST · ESCALATION → ① SCHEDULER · closed self-steering loop (FLUSH each cycle)
chimera/core/loop.py — invocation-driven cycle; one beat per `chimera run`; 9 named phases HOUSEKEEPING→…→ROTATE (COMMIT is a stub).
cycle restored from file, not DB
② TASK SHAPING · SPLIT · ENTROPY SUB-TASKING
core/task_splitter.py + escalation.py — reshape bundled INBOX tasks: heuristic+model splitter, research/complexity tier floor, entropy fan-out.
stale pre-filter, fail-open on gh err
③ ACT · PARALLEL TOOL DISPATCH & GUARDS
core/act.py (+act_guards.py) — multi-round tool loop: fan out a round's tool_uses concurrently, then ~20 completion guards flip completed=False.
lexical v0 prefilter; core floor on
providers/* — 4 tier ladders (haiku/sonnet/opus/code), cheapest-rung-first; escalation memory promotes a failed task one tier next attempt.
core/budget.py — three orthogonal spend guards checked BEFORE every provider call; prospective `estimate` + retrospective `cost` CLI.
checked at top of each ACT round
ACT diff → critic gate + witness panel
core/{critic_gate,witness_panel,scope_check,repo_verify,differential} — fail-closed gates block unfaithful or off-charter commits.
runs real ruff + pytest on worktree
diffs fn output base vs changed
⑦ MEMORY · KFM ONTOLOGY · GRAPH · WIKI RECALL
memory/* + core/kfm.py — SQLite is the source of truth (KFM entities/transitions/api_calls); Kuzu graph + FTS5 wiki are derived recall.
linear; exactly one op per transition
pure fn: never raises, no DB (0001)
⑧ AUTONOMOUS ENGINES · DRIFT · TRUST · ADAPTATION
engines/ + drift/ + trust/ — 3 gated engines write chronicles/propose mutations; composite drift + T0–T5 trust close the loop in FLUSH.
core/self_pr.py + proposals/ — Chimera scans itself, authors charters, opens trust-gated DRAFT PRs to its own and foreign repos.
skills/ + positioning/ + prompts/ — assemble/validate dynamic skills via a tier ladder + witnesses; positioning guards runtime; build the prompt.
⑪ A2A · FEDERATION · MCP SERVER · TRUST POLICY
a2a/ + server/ — Chimera as MCP server (stdio + HTTP/SSE bearer); FS peer registry; ALLOW/DEGRADE/REFUSE trust gate; dialectic/emergence.
register on serve, forget on exit
control-plane/ (read-only Next.js 15 over SQLite, Review default) + config.py central ~90-flag registry + container bootstrap.
CI fails on undeclared flag read
• Invocation-driven: one cycle per chimera run — no daemon
• 9 phases; SLEEP-free; COMMIT is a stub (git deferred)
• Opus planner every 4 cyc · session ≤12h → ROTATE
cadence external: soak runner / cron re-invokes run
opus ladder INVERTED: deepseek-v4-pro leads, opus last (~34×)
• Web Exa / Brave / Tavily · GitHub gh DRAFT PRs
3 caps BEFORE every call: cycle $2 · hour $20 · task $5
• 0 disables a cap; trip = spend not failure → no promote
• Critic gate fail-closed · verdict bound to diff --cached
• Cross-provider witness panel (3, pool 5) — any dissent → reject
• Scope guards fail-closed: off-charter commit refused
• Non-loopback MCP bind needs token + TLS, else refused
• T0 → ACT observer mode (all dispatch off)
• Self-/Foreign-PR: DRAFT only; trust ≥T4; first-5 gated
~90 CHIMERA_* flags, one registry, CI pairwise matrix (0176)
• cost_runaway_drill — trips the 3 caps on purpose
• flag registry: undeclared read fails CI (0176)
• pairwise HIGH_IMPACT flag matrix in CI
ACT fail → task_escalations → next cycle one tier up
FLUSH: observe → drift assess → demote plan / lockdown
crawl merge_rate / revert_rate → RUN auto-merge graduation
Kuzu graph + FTS5 wiki = DERIVED, rebuildable (~95% skip)
cycle counter restored from HEARTBEAT.md, not the DB
Repo: elementalcollision/chimera · entrypoint chimera = chimera.cli:main · one 9-phase cycle per chimera run (live loop in chimera/core/loop.py) · 439 files · 188 ADRs.

Grounded in a 12-agent CodeGraph map of the repo. Boxes name the primary module + real symbols; facts cite thresholds, env flags (CHIMERA_*) and ADR numbers. Derived recall (Kuzu / FTS5) is rebuildable; SQLite + mind/ are canonical.
